verdict.rationale: Square documents a scope-controlled OAuth access-token model with per-permission scopes. Its hosted remote MCP server explicitly supports OAuth login with "granular permissions," so an agent can be authorized for "only the scopes your application needs" without manual token handling. The local MCP server also offers a documented read-only restriction (DISALLOW_WRITES). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the scope catalog and of token expiry/revocation for agent credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scoped agent credentials work as described.
